lagfixer.config.title: Lag Fixer Settings
lagfixer.config.hopper.tooltip: Experimental: changes hopper tick timing. Off by default; test technical builds carefully.
lagfixer.config.entity.tooltip: Experimental: reduces distant mob AI frequency and may change behavior. Off by default.
lagfixer.config.redstone.tooltip: Experimental and unsafe for technical worlds. Off by default pending dependency-aware invalidation.
lagfixer.config.collision.tooltip: Experimental: dynamic block shapes may depend on position and neighbors. Off by default.
lagfixer.config.render.tooltip: Enforces particle count and render distance caps. Applies on any server, including ones you do not administer.
lagfixer.config.aiSkipTicks.tooltip: How many ticks to skip between AI evaluations for idle/distant mobs. Higher = more performance, less responsive AI.
lagfixer.config.maxParticles.tooltip: Maximum number of particles rendered at once. Lower values improve FPS on weak GPUs.
lagfixer.config.renderDistCap.tooltip: Maximum render distance in chunks. Caps the vanilla video setting.
lagfixer.config.presets.note: Safe presets keep experimental logic mixins off. Render limits update live; mixin switches require restart.
lagfixer.config.preset.potato.tooltip: Safe logic defaults. Particles: 100. Render distance: 6. For the weakest hardware.
lagfixer.config.preset.balanced.tooltip: Safe logic defaults. Particles: 500. Render distance: 12. Recommended default.
lagfixer.config.preset.quality.tooltip: Safe logic defaults. Particles: 2000. Render distance: 20. For capable hardware.
